name: How long does it take to clear a clogged shower drain?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to clear a clogged shower drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time it takes to clear a clogged shower drain can vary significantly. Simple clogs, such as those caused by hair and soap scum near the drain opening, can often be cleared in under an hour by a professional. More complex or deeply embedded clogs, those requiring camera inspection, or hydro-jetting for thorough cleaning, might take a few hours to complete. Factors like the age and condition of your plumbing system can also influence the duration. Alpha-Plumbing Services works efficiently to resolve the issue while ensuring a complete and lasting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clearing a shower drain clog can take under an hour for simple issues, but more complex clogs or those requiring specialized tools might take a few hours.
